target: Decide existence of a maximal-cardinality 1-resolvable quantum Latin square of order10.
primary: Zhang–Cao arXiv:2608.29201v2 Definition1.1,Theorem1.3 and named exceptional order10

scope.vectors: 100 unit vectors q_ij in C^10, i,j=0..9
scope.QLS: Every row and every column is an orthonormal basis.
scope.resolution: Ten disjoint sets T_s partition all100 cells; each has exactly one cell in each row and column and its10 vectors form an orthonormal basis.
scope.maximal_cardinality: All100 entries are pairwise distinct modulo arbitrary global phase, i.e. no two are parallel rays.
scope.negative: Nonexistence must cover arbitrary complex vectors and every resolution, not a fixed Latin mate, ansatz, field or symmetry.

requirements: Check nearby symmetric/idempotent and full-rank constructions/citers for applicability; stop immediately if prior resolution found.
Freeze representation/derivation and baseline before search; no larger brute-force range alone.
Exact witness and complete transversal data, not numeric rounding; rigorous exact arithmetic for all inner products and nonparallel-ray checks.
Parent definition-level checker, independent implementations and intended-reason controls, plus producer reproducibility and both Codex/Claude hostile review before a gate.
Correctness, priority and significance separate; no publication/contact or novelty-from-miss.
initial_permission: Written structural work and <=5-minute standard-library arithmetic probes only after freezing the probe source/rule; no external native solver or expensive enumeration before new explicit parent GO.
preservation: Only new lane files created exclusively; corrections new versions/addenda; predecessors unchanged. No deletions,/tmp,Git mutation,paid APIs,global config,old-engine changes or external contact.
